itens.titulo: Nvidia Would Have to Add Almost a Whole Broadcom to Reach $7 Trillion
itens.descricao: Nvidia Would Have to Add Almost a Whole Broadcom to Reach $7 Trillion Yahoo Finance
trechos: Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), the world's most valuable company, is worth around $5.45 trillion as of this writing.
The next big round number is $7 trillion.
And the gap between them is larger than it sounds: roughly $1.55 trillion, or nearly the full market value of Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO), the $1.69 trillion chip and infrastructure software business.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
The climb itself looks normal After all, fewer than 10 other companies in the world are worth more than the gap itself.
From around $225 as I write this, a $7 trillion market cap comes out to around $290 a share -- a rise of around 28%.
For context, shares have climbed 37% from their 52-week low, and they now trade within around 5% of their 52-week high.

itens.titulo: Chevron (CVX) Plans a Major Exploration Push: What Investors Need to Know
itens.descricao: Chevron (CVX) Plans a Major Exploration Push: What Investors Need to Know Yahoo Finance
trechos: Kevin McLachlan, who joined Chevron Corporation (NYSE:CVX) last year to lead the exploration arm, told the Financial Times that his budget would increase by more than 50% compared with 2025.
The company plans to drill about 20 exploration wells next year, compared with 10 wells two years ago, along with another five or six appraisal wells.
Chevron is also committing billions to expand production elsewhere, raising a broader question about whether Chevron's higher exploration spending can lead to meaningful new discoveries.
Read More Here: Chevron (CVX) Doubles Down on Venezuela with a $7 Billion Oil Bet Exploration spending is expected to exceed $1.5 billion in 2026, compared with just under $1 billion last year.
The company's total exploration acreage has doubled since 2024.

According to Wood Mackenzie data cited by the Financial Times, the company's conventional exploration and appraisal spending fell 36% to $1.82 billion during 2021–2025 compared with the previous five-year period.
The company paid $12.8 billion in dividends in 2025.
During its November 2025 Investor Day, the company outlined its plan to grow its adjusted free cash flow by more than 10% annually at $70 Brent.

itens.descricao: Ibovespa cai 0,27% e dólar recua a R$ 5,182 Poder360
trechos: Ibovespa cai 0,27% e dólar recua a R$ 5,182 Bolsa brasileira fechou em 183.476,86 pontos; petróleo em queda e IPCA-15 acima do esperado pressionaram mercado O Ibovespa caiu 0,27%, aos 183.476,86 pontos, nesta 6ª feira (25.set.2026).
O dólar comercial recuou 0,23%, a R$ 5,182.
Durante o pregão, o índice chegou a cair 0,99%, mas reduziu as perdas ao longo do dia.
Na semana, o Ibovespa acumulou baixa de 0,95%.
IPCA-15 PRESSIONA MERCADO O mercado repercutiu o resultado do IPCA-15 (Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor Amplo 15) de setembro, divulgado pelo IBGE.
O indicador subiu 0,70% no mês, acima da mediana das projeções do mercado.
Em 12 meses, a inflação medida pelo IPCA-15 acelerou de 4,24% para 4,47%, ultrapassando o teto da meta de inflação.
O rendimento da Treasury de 10 anos superou 5,2% na sessão anterior, maior nível desde 2007.

itens.titulo: Is Now the Time to Bet on Intel’s (INTC) Server CPU Comeback and AI Ambitions?
itens.descricao: Is Now the Time to Bet on Intel’s (INTC) Server CPU Comeback and AI Ambitions? Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Intel Corp. (NASDAQ:INTC) is advancing its semiconductor manufacturing strategy through its 18A process, expanding its foundry operations, and developing new AI-focused and high-performance processors.
Photo by Slejven Djurakovic on Unsplash Is Altera Stake a Hidden Catalyst Intel's 49% existing stake in chipmaker, Altera, offers interesting prospects to shareholders.
Altera is on course to return to the public markets after 11 years, as its parent company has confidentially submitted a draft registration statement for a proposed IPO.
It was acquired by Intel for $16.7 billion in 2015, before Silver Lake bought a controlling stake of 51% in 2025.

Going public could unlock valuation for Altera, which Intel would be looking forward to, as the company plans on a large-scale spending to expand its foundry business through major technological milestones like the 18A and 14A nodes.
Intel's involvement in the massive "Terafab" semiconductor initiative, involving SpaceX and Tesla, does offer long-term potential around AI compute capacity expansion.
Institutional Sentiment Based on data tracked across 1,000+ hedge funds by Insider Monkey, institutional sentiment toward the company remains encouraging.
According to 13F filing data, number of smart-money managers in the stock has been going up.

trechos: Ao longo do pregão, o índice oscilou entre 182.151,01 pontos na mínima e 184.214,48 pontos na máxima, com giro financeiro de R$ 23,5 bilhões.

Prio (PRIO3) também foi pressionada pela commodity e recuou 2,24%.
Na direção contrária, Vale (VALE3) avançou 0,16%.

itens.titulo: Stock Market Today, Sept. 25: Nike Downgraded by Bank of America, Shares Flat
itens.descricao: Stock Market Today, Sept. 25: Nike Downgraded by Bank of America, Shares Flat Yahoo Finance
trechos: NIKE (NYSE:NKE), a global athletic footwear and apparel brand, closed at $35.75, down 0.67%.
Bank of America downgraded NIKE and cut its price target on the stock from $47 to $30.
1 earnings report and for any potential guidance.
Trading volume reached 34.2M shares, coming in nearly 23% above its three-month average of 27.8M shares.
How the markets moved today The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) rose 0.49% to 7,742, and the Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) rose 0.48% to 27,069.

Among athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories peers, lululemon athletica (NASDAQ:LULU) closed at $101.30, down 0.33%, while Under Armour (NYSE:UAA) closed at $4.42, down 1.67%, showing mixed pressure across the category.
What this means for investors An analyst with Bank of America lowered their price target on Nike stock from $47 to $30 on Friday, but the apparel juggernaut's shares largely remained flat.
The analyst lowered their EPS estimates for Nike to $1.43 in 2027 and $1.87 in 2028, as they see the company's slow-but-steady turnaround taking even longer than already expected.

itens.titulo: Palantir vs. Snowflake: Which Enterprise AI Stock Better Justifies Its Valuation?
itens.descricao: Palantir vs. Snowflake: Which Enterprise AI Stock Better Justifies Its Valuation? Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Palantir trades near 45 times forward sales and roughly 130 times free cash flow, while Snowflake trades around 16 times forward sales and about 99 times free cash flow.

Palantir's recent $127 million Army order sharpened the question of whether its valuation has finally outrun even excellent execution, while Snowflake's recent earnings showed how quickly AI consumption can change the market's view of a data-platform stock.
Palantir is growing fast enough to make absurd multiples debatable Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ:PLTR)'s second-quarter revenue rose 93% to $1.94 billion.
commercial revenue jumped 149% to $764 million, adjusted operating margin reached 62%, and adjusted free cash flow was $1.22 billion, equal to 63% of revenue.
A 45 times forward-sales multiple means even a sharp deceleration can compress the stock before the underlying business becomes weak.
It had 828 customers generating more than $1 million of trailing product revenue.
Management now expects full-year product revenue of $6.07 billion, up 36%, with an adjusted free cash flow margin of 23%.
Snowflake's second-quarter adjusted free cash flow margin was 6%, unchanged from the year-earlier period, while its 23% full-year guidance remains below the 25% achieved in FY26.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa cai 0,25% com Petrobras nesta sexta e acumula perdas de 0,95% na semana
itens.descricao: Ibovespa cai 0,25% com Petrobras nesta sexta e acumula perdas de 0,95% na semana InfoMoney
trechos: Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa cedeu 0,27%, a 183.476,86 pontos, chegando a 182.151,01 no pior momento.
Na máxima, atingiu 184.214,48 pontos.
Na semana, acumulou um declínio de 0,95%.
O volume financeiro nesta sexta-feira somou R$ 23,99 bilhões.
Em Wall Street, o S&P 500 fechou com elevação de 0,51%.
“O cenário externo contribuiu para limitar as perdas”, afirmou o analista Matheus Villela, da gestora de patrimônio Aware Investments.

Ele chamou a atenção para a pesquisa Datafolha, que mostrou Lula com 40% das intenções de voto no primeiro turno, contra 36% de Flávio, enquanto o cenário para potencial segundo turno apontou 47% a 45%, respectivamente.
“A variação foi de apenas um ponto e está dentro da margem de erro, mas o mercado tem precificado qualquer mudança de tendência”, afirmou Villela.
